reviews.title: Don't Hestitate to Order
reviews.body: This was such a great purchase, and on top of that was so reasonably priced! I bought it for my 19 month old grandson. He loves to watch what his Mom & Dad are doing and mimic them. Since his Dad does a lot of improvement tasks around the house with a drill, screw driver, wrenches, hammer & saw, I thought he might like this. He LOVES it! His mother was able to put it together herself, and likes that it can be taken apart to transition into just a tool box. Love that the drill can actually rotate the toy screws in & out (IT IS REVERSABLE!), and that the miter saw rotates. with all the tools included it will serve as a good way to learn about how tools work and their names. It also comes with a little construction workers vest! Such a great learning, fun toy for toddlers & young children!

features: 【Safe Materials】 Toy tool bench is made of high-quality ABS plastic, more durable and more environmental. Easy to assemble and disassemble, no odor, smooth surface, no sharp edges and children can play safely.

【Kids workbench with clothes】 This toddler work bench comes with a power drill and different heads to practice, a mechanical miter saw, a screwdriver with screws, nuts, and bolts, a claw hammer, and different wrenches, a plier, a hand saw, and other play tools. Which helps your kid enhance his creativity and build new skills at a young age.

【Tool Box & Workbench in One Design】 You can turn a toolbox into a tool bench by assembling, and when you're done playing, you can take it apart and turn it back into a toolbox. Designed to be compact and convenient, your child can easily carry it around whether travelling, partying or in the backyard.

【Develop your child's skills】 Well-built kids tool set features high-quality materials and a steady structure, making it safe for kids to entertain for a long time. The tray underneath the kids workbench is large and deep enough to hold all pieces. The table top of the toy workbench is great for pretending to cut or drill, giving kids' imagination a boost.

【Perfect gift for kids ages 3-5】 The perfect gift for birthday parties, awards, prizes, Christmas, New Year and other occasions for children aged 3-5 years. If you are not satisfied with the tool toy for any reason, please contact us immediately.
